notes.title: BANDITS PRE ALPHA 0.5 !!
notes.content:
[h1]HELLO ALL!![/h1]

first and foremost thank you to everyone who is playing and breaking this game i love you so much!!!!


a very very special thanks to DefianceLlame and KarBay for taking me under their survival wings and really showing me the ropes when it comes to the ins and outs of how survival games typically work. Feel like I got a crash course on Friday which really helped me in my overall approach to the development of BANDITS!!

[h1]NOW LETS GET TO THESE UPDATES[/h1]

[h2]MONEY SYSTEM [/h2]
the money system now works!!

[h2]SHOPS[/h2]
money can be spent at:

[b]COMMISARY 
BLACK MARKET 
ARMORY[/b]

added these three shops which players can sell and buy various items. not gonna spoil too much but the system is there and ready to be broken lol 

[h2]NEW WEAPONS[/h2]
auto rifle 
military shot gun 
burst pistol 
revolver 
loaded pistol mag
loaded rifle mag 

btw all the new weapons come FULL LOADED and can be loaded directly from the hot bar or chambered without doing all the extra lol 

[h2]NEW BUILD PARTS[/h2]
4 new beds
electronics shelf
light pole
4 generic rugs
1 bear rug
a few different posters and signs

[h2]BIGGER STORAGE[/h2]
As requested I have added two new LARGER storage boxes to the game for all your storage needs. 

[h2]NEW LAND MARKS[/h2]

TUNDRA
DESERT BUNKS
FOREST RESEARCH LAB 

[h2]MONEY MACHINE[/h2]
The money machine has been added and now players can convert dirty money to clean money and clean money to dirty money via the money machine which can either be crafted or used publicly at one of the shops. 

[h2]LITE WEATHER SYSTEM[/h2]
There is now a light weather system in the game containing rain and snow. Please be patient as I work towards getting this system full fleshed out, there may be some times where the rain drops continue on the HUD even if it is not raining but I plan on getting this taken care of in a hot fox coming rather quickly. Other than that the system works and should be synced in multiplayer. 

[h2]FOG SYSTEM[/h2]
With the weather system comes a lite fog system. I am still playing with the values to set the right mood but with that being said there might be some issues with the density of the fog. Nothing game breaking you just really have to have your wits about you as the fog adds in a new layer of "sneaky-ness" LOL 

[h2]SYTLIZED SKY[/h2]
implemented a stylized sky into the game which may be out of sync or multiplayer for now. I still have to set the variables in the game mode so that the server set the time and is synced up. many apologies however this does add to the overall atmosphere of the game and mood/.

[h2]MASSIVE BACK END BUILDING ISSUES[/h2]
Fixed a massive issue on the back end where a majority of the build parts being given at the crafting bench were not matching up with the corresponding build part. This has been solved and all build parts should correspond together. Build part collision has also been removed from furniture items so players can place furniture items pretty much anywhere. 

[h2]RANDOM ITEM SPAWNING[/h2]
Random items in crates and resource points will now spawn at beginning of the game and on a timer of about 5 minutes. This is to ensure there are always new items being spawned in a timely fashion as well as to ensure that there at items in chest if you happen to reach one before the timer runs out.

[h2]ENEMY DESPAWN TIME[/h2]
enemy despawn timer has been increased
deer now drop animal hide for the bear rug
AI soldiers will now drop brick, packs and spawn random items on death 

[h2]NEW ENEMY[/h2]
New enemy soldier "elite" has been added to the game. these soldiers carry blue prints for all high level weapons. you cannot craft high level weapons without a blue print. they much be bought or researched.  these new enemies are not a joke and have almost triple the amount of health as the normal soldiers. they are wearing RED. be on the lookout as they will completely destroy you if not prepped for the encounter.

[h2]STARTING WEAPON[/h2]
Players will now start with a knife. I am in the process of adding in mele but felt this a fair means of protection. now if and when you die.. you WILL NOT RESPOND WITH YOUR KNIFE. YOU DIED AND THAT'S ON YOU. 

[h2]FRONT FACING CAMERA [/h2]
there is now a front facing camera by hitting the "v" key players can see the snazzy clothing items they have on. 

[h2]DYING WARNING [/h2]
a major request... lol.. there is now a sound when you take damage and when you are starving/dehydrated. still tweaking the sound but I heard yall so I had to rectify this issue immediately!

[h2]REAL TIME MINI MAP[/h2]
there is now a very very very crude real time mini map when you hit the "t" key. now this is still super super early but just wanted to give it to yall as I had heard it various times during the play test. 


ALRIGHT I THINK THAT'S IT!!

As you can see I went kind of ham this weekend.. lol.. just wanted to make sure yall are getting the best version of what i am capable of right now! Again, I just want to emphasize how thankful I am for each and every one of yall just even giving bandits a try.

 oh and one last thing i wanted to say is that this is not deadpoly or surroundead lol like i know it is VERY SIMILAR and uses the same assets.. BUT IT IS BANDITS NOT ANY OTHER GAME. so if you are playing.. expecting the same experience as dead poly or surrounded..  then im sorry.. you will be GREATLY disappointed. and i say that with so much love. im not trying to make the same game as anybody else. im just making MY game and hoping it finds the right audience. if that rubs you the wrong way i really dont care lol shout out to all my bandits.. WE ARE JUST GETTING STARTED !!! 

xoxo 

QUINN aka PAXX STACKS !!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2
notes.content:
[b]hot fix 0.2[/b]

- fixed more build part collision so should be able to place furniture items
- fixed cook up station not spawning in when crafted
- foliage respawn times (specifically iron ore)
- fixed furnace not being available at the crafting bench
- furnace crafting cost
- added more storage to crafting bench
- fixed cooking station
- there is now a kill zone under the map if you choose to jump off lol
- water now depletes at a much slower rate
- terrain around hangers is now flat so buildings dont hang off edge
- weapon spawning probability has changed
- generator build collision has been adjusted again
- tweaked generator proximity

notes.title: UPDATE 0.1
notes.content:
[b]hot fix 0.1[/b]

- storage no longer requires generator
- generator no longer requires generator to craft its self
- pills can now be stack up to 15 each
- bandages can now be stacked up to 15 each
- fixed death rose collison, should now be able to pick up
- increased battery spawn probability
- iron nodes will now give stone and iron until the procedural spawning probability is fixed

notes.title: WELCOME TO PRE ALPHA DEMO V 0.0!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello to my fellow BANDITS![/h1]

WOW I CANNOT BELIVE WE ARE HERE! Thank you to anyone who is reading this and actually taking time time out of your precious day to play my game!! 

My name is Quinn but you can find me on pretty much every social platform as PAXX STACKS ! I’m a kid from the mid-west who loves video games!! Currently living the dream in Indiana with my wife and daughter! Enough about me though let’s talk about BANDITS!

[h2][b]BUG CATCHERS[/b][/h2]

- PLEASE HELP ME BREAK THE GAME AND FIND BUGS!!
- This is a pretty large map for one person to be managing so naturally I will not be able to catch every bug! Which is exactly why I need your help! Please go crazy and break the game. Put it through the ringer. We need to make it cry! Lol only so we can kill off the bugs now and make for a better experience for early access!
- Also anyone wanting to Become a part of development/art/WHATEVER.. just reach out!! I’m doing all dev in unreal engine and posting progress every day on YouTube!!
- Wisebeargames@gmail.com
- Below are some bugs I wanted to be upfront about that I currently am aware of! I am sure there are millions but these are ones I felt could potentially make the game less enjoyable so found it best to let you know before you even load up.

[h2]Known bugs[/h2]

- foot steps playing twice when holding hammer and certain rifles
- Certain foliage collision is not set correctly so you won’t be able to pick up its resource
- AI foot steps are kinda loud right now lol but find I find them super helpful
- The money system is not fully in place, but you can still grow all the plants and harvest their resources
- Proximity of generator to crafting bench needs tweaking
- Consumable resources may not be spawning as thick as trees and rocks
- Lots of hats/helmets spawning in the chests - this will change as I update the spawning probability as well as add in more build parts and items to the data table that it pulls from

 [h3] DEDICATED SERVERS[/h3]

- I 1000% am going to make a dedicated sever by the end of the year I just want to make sure I have 90% of the systems built out and added in before switching over to a source build of unreal engine! I could switch over right now it’s just a bit of a process and I would prefer to have as much completed as possible before shifting to a full alpha build with public servers.

[h1]FIRST MAJOR UPDATE[/h1]

- the first major update will primarily consist of more build parts and giving players more options in base customization. The reason I did not include many options initially because I feel many other survival games, especially low poly indie, rely heavily on a bunch of building parts that serve no immediate purpose to the players. So in my case I’d rather focus on functionality over beautification atleast in this initial drop. However, moving forward each build part aside from storage and needed parts for progression will also have multiple in game functions!

[h3]HUGS AND KISSES[/h3]

This really means the world to me, and I just want to say thank you again for giving me a chance to entertain you with my art!! I will see y’all soon! Tap in on YouTube or Discord!!
